name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
nameTa: தேசிய கால்நடை இயக்கம் (NLM)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Govt of India
description: Comprehensive central mission to develop livestock entrepreneurship, improve native breeds of sheep, goat, poultry, and pigs, and bridge the feed-fodder supply deficit.
benefits: Up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50 Lakhs) for establishing sheep, goat, poultry, and pig breeding units.
Up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50 Lakhs) for fodder block, silage, and Total Mixed Ration (TMR) processing plants.
Support for certified fodder seed production and livestock insurance premium sharing.
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural entrepreneurs, Self Help Groups (SHGs), Joint Liability Groups (JLGs), and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
Must possess or lease suitable land for establishing the breeding or rearing farm.
Must have training or practical experience in animal rearing and livestock management.
requiredDocuments: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with techno-economic feasibility
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Proof of land ownership (Patta) or registered lease deed (minimum 8-10 years)
Bank account details and bank loan sanction letter or self-finance proof
Training certificate in animal husbandry or livestock rearing
notes: Applications must be submitted digitally via the official NLM Udyami Mitra portal. Sanction is subject to State Level Executive Committee (SLEC) and bank appraisal.

name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
nameTa: ராஷ்ட்ரிய கோகுல் இயக்கம் (நாட்டு மாடுகள் பாதுகாப்பு திட்டம்)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Govt of India
description: National initiative for genetic upgradation of bovine population, development and scientific conservation of indigenous cattle and buffalo breeds, and enhancing per-animal milk productivity.
benefits: Subsidies up to 50% on the cost of sex-sorted semen doses to ensure high probability of female calves (>90%).
Subsidized/free doorstep Artificial Insemination (AI) services delivered through Multi-Purpose AI Technicians in Rural India (MAITRIs).
Financial assistance per successful pregnancy achieved via In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) technology for registered farmers.
Up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Crores) for establishing elite indigenous Breed Multiplication Farms.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, dairy owners, and gaushalas rearing indigenous or crossbred bovines.
Breed multiplication farm component is open to entrepreneurs, cooperatives, and FPOs with suitable bovine holding capacity.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card copy
Pashu Aadhaar / Bharat Pashudhan 12-digit ear tag number
Bank passbook copy with IFSC code
Land Patta or shed ownership document (for breed farm component)
notes: Artificial insemination services are actively available at veterinary institutions. Capital subsidies for private breed multiplication farms require periodic departmental notification and call for proposals.

name: Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme (LHDCP)
nameTa: கால்நடை நலம் மற்றும் நோய் தடுப்புத் திட்டம் (LHDCP)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Govt of India & State Animal Husbandry Dept
description: Centrally sponsored programme to eradicate economic animal diseases through systematic biannual mass vaccination, disease surveillance, and veterinary healthcare strengthening.
benefits: 100% free mass prophylactic vaccination of cattle and buffaloes against Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) every 6 months.
100% free vaccination for female calves against Brucellosis and small ruminants against Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR).
Free 12-digit unique polyurethane ear tagging and digital health tracking on the Bharat Pashudhan portal.
eligibility: All livestock farmers owning cattle, buffaloes, sheep, goats, or pigs in all notified rural districts.
requiredDocuments: Pashu Aadhaar Ear Tag identification
Farmer Aadhaar and mobile number for Bharat Pashudhan portal entry
notes: Vaccination camps are conducted at village level twice annually by Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry veterinary dispensaries.

name: National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD)
nameTa: தேசிய பால்வள மேம்பாட்டு திட்டம் (NPDD)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD) & National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)
description: Strengthens rural dairy procurement infrastructure, promotes clean milk production, and equips primary dairy cooperative societies with electronic milk testing and chilling units.
benefits: Financial assistance to set up Automated Milk Collection Units (AMCUs) and Data Processor Milk Collection Units (DPMCUs) at village societies.
Installation of Bulk Milk Coolers (BMCs) to prevent bacterial degradation and maintain milk quality before processing.
Subsidized testing kits to identify milk adulterants at village collection centers.
eligibility: Primary Dairy Cooperative Societies (Aavin affiliated in Tamil Nadu), Milk Producer Companies (MPCs), and dairy-based FPOs.
Individual milk pouring farmers benefit directly through transparent fat/SNF-based instant digital payments.
requiredDocuments: Dairy cooperative society registration certificate
Membership passbook of the milk pouring farmer
Society bank account details
notes: Institutional infrastructure assistance for State Dairy Federations (Aavin) and District Milk Unions. Individual farmers benefit through membership in Primary Dairy Cooperative Societies; no direct individual walk-in application portal.

name: Supporting Dairy Cooperatives & Farmer Producer Organisations (SDCFPO)
nameTa: பால் உற்பத்தியாளர்கள் கூட்டுறவு மற்றும் உழவர் உற்பத்தியாளர் நிறுவனங்களுக்கான ஆதரவுத் திட்டம்
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD) & National Dairy Development Board (NDDB)
description: Provides working capital interest subvention to dairy cooperative federations and farmer producer organizations to ensure uninterrupted milk procurement from rural farmers during market shocks.
benefits: 2% per annum regular interest subvention on working capital loans availed by dairy cooperatives and FPOs.
Additional 2% per annum incentive subvention for prompt and timely repayment of loans.
Assures stable, unhindered daily milk procurement and timely weekly payments to rural pouring farmers.
eligibility: State Cooperative Dairy Federations, District Cooperative Milk Unions, and registered dairy-focused Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs).
requiredDocuments: Audited financial statements of the cooperative/FPO
Bank sanction letter for working capital credit line
Proof of direct milk procurement from farmer members
notes: Loan interest subvention scheme administered by NDDB for State Milk Federations and FPOs. Not open for direct individual retail farmer applications.

name: Tamil Nadu Livestock Insurance Scheme
nameTa: தமிழ்நாடு கால்நடை காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Govt of Tamil Nadu & TNLDA
description: Comprehensive risk mitigation scheme providing subsidized insurance cover against accidental mortality, disease epidemics, and transit hazards for cattle, buffaloes, sheep, and goats.
benefits: 50% to 70% government subsidy on insurance premiums for indigenous, crossbred milch cows, breeding bulls, and small ruminants.
Comprehensive insurance claim settlement (up to the full market value assessed by veterinary assistant surgeon) in event of accidental death or epidemic disease.
100% premium subsidy provided for eligible beneficiaries under designated special state welfare schemes.
eligibility: Farmers owning crossbred or high-yielding indigenous milch cows, she-buffaloes, sheep, or goats in Tamil Nadu.
Animals must be certified healthy and non-pregnant by a registered Veterinary Assistant Surgeon.
Must have official Pashu Aadhaar ear tag affixed.
requiredDocuments: Veterinary health certificate and valuation report
Pashu Aadhaar ear-tag photograph
Farmer Aadhaar Card and bank passbook copy
Signed insurance proposal form
notes: Subsidized livestock insurance is sanctioned subject to annual district target quotas allocated by TNLDA to local Veterinary Dispensaries. Confirm quota availability with your local Veterinary Assistant Surgeon.

name: Tamil Nadu Free Distribution of Milch Cows Scheme
nameTa: இலவச கறவை மாடுகள் வழங்கும் திட்டம் (தமிழ்நாடு அரசு)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Flagship rural welfare initiative supplying productive crossbred milch cows to economically disadvantaged rural women and landless agricultural households to establish stable dairy income.
benefits: 100% government grant for purchasing productive lactating crossbred or indigenous milch cows.
Government-funded transport allowance to bring cows from shandies to beneficiary villages.
Free initial insurance coverage and veterinary vaccination support for 1 year.
Automatic linkage with primary dairy cooperative societies (Aavin) for daily milk sale.
eligibility: Rural women, landless agricultural laborers, destitute widows, and economically weaker households residing in selected village panchayats.
Beneficiary family should not own cultivable wet land or existing milch cows.
Selection finalized through village Grama Sabha consensus.
requiredDocuments: Ration Card / Smart Family Card copy
Aadhaar Card
Income and Community Certificate issued by Tahsildar
Bank passbook copy (Aadhaar linked)
notes: Departmental scheme for ultra-poor landless women. Beneficiaries are identified at the village panchayat level by a committee and approved in Grama Sabhas; no open public online portal. Contact local Veterinary Assistant Surgeon.

name: Tamil Nadu Vetri Magalir Goat & Sheep Livelihood Scheme
nameTa: வெற்றி மகளிர் ஆடுகள் வளர்ப்புத் திட்டம் (இலவச செம்மறி / வெள்ளாடுகள்)
department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Targeted rural livelihood scheme providing units of female goats or sheep with 100% subsidy to rural women, widows, and marginalized households for supplementary income generation.
benefits: 100% government subsidy providing units of 5 sheep or goats per eligible rural woman beneficiary.
Comprehensive government funding covering transport allowance, deworming, vaccination, and first-year livestock insurance.
Training on scientific goat and sheep shelter management, nutrition, and disease prevention.
eligibility: Rural women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, destitute widows, deserted women, and agricultural labor households.
Applicant must be a permanent resident of the designated village panchayat.
requiredDocuments: Smart Ration Card copy
Aadhaar Card copy
BPL Certificate or VAO Residence & Livelihood Certificate
Bank Account Passbook
notes: Beneficiary selection (4 goats/sheep per eligible woman) conducted periodically through Grama Sabhas and Village Poverty Reduction Committees under Animal Husbandry department guidelines. Contact local Veterinary Assistant Surgeon.

name: Tamil Nadu Fodder Development & Seed Distribution Scheme
nameTa: பசுந்தீவன அபிவிருத்தி மற்றும் தீவன விதை வழங்கல் திட்டம்
department: Department of Animal Husbandry & Agriculture, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Encourages cultivation of nutrient-dense perennial green fodder crops to eliminate feed shortages, enhance animal immunity, and reduce daily concentrate feeding expenses for dairy farmers.
benefits: Free or 75% subsidized distribution of certified perennial green fodder stem cuttings and slips (Co-4, Co-5, Super Napier).
Supply of high-yielding fodder sorghum (CoFS-29 / CoFS-31) and legume seeds (Cowpea, Desmanthus).
Subsidized power-operated chaff cutters (up to 50% subsidy) to minimize fodder wastage during feeding.
eligibility: Farmers owning cattle, buffaloes, sheep, or goats with minimum 0.25 to 1 acre of land having assured irrigation facilities.
requiredDocuments: Land Patta / Chitta extract
Aadhaar Card copy
Animal holding certificate or Pashu Aadhaar ear tag details
notes: Fodder seeds, slips (Co-FS-29/Napier), and chaff cutter units distributed through Veterinary Dispensaries during seasonal agricultural campaigns subject to stock availability.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Crop Insurance
nameTa: பிரதம மந்திரி பயிர் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம் (PMFBY)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India & State Agriculture Directorate
description: Comprehensive yield-based crop insurance providing financial safety against non-preventable natural calamities (cyclones, drought, flood, pests) from pre-sowing to post-harvest storage.
benefits: Maximum farmer premium capped at 2.0% for Kharif/Samba food crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5.0% for annual commercial/horticultural crops; remaining premium paid by State and Central Governments.
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) claim settlement based on satellite remote sensing and crop cutting experiments (CCE).
Localized calamity coverage (hailstorms, landslide, inundation) with claim intimation window within 72 hours.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops (such as Samba Paddy, Millets, Cotton, Pulses, Groundnut, Sugarcane) in notified revenue villages.
Both loanee farmers (holding crop loans) and non-loanee farmers are equally eligible.
requiredDocuments: Crop Sowing Certificate (Adangal) issued by Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
Land Patta / Chitta ownership extract
Aadhaar Card copy
Cancelled bank cheque or active passbook front page with IFSC code
notes: Non-loanee farmers can enroll via Common Service Centres (CSC), Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Societies (PACCS), or the PMFBY portal before the seasonal cut-off date.

name: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)
nameTa: வானிலை அடிப்படையிலான மறுசீரமைக்கப்பட்ட பயிர் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம் (RWBCIS)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
description: Parametric weather-indexed insurance providing fast compensation against anticipated crop losses caused by adverse weather conditions such as unseasonal rainfall, temperature spikes, or relative humidity anomalies.
benefits: Parametric payout triggered automatically whenever weather station readings breach pre-defined agronomic trigger levels, eliminating waiting time for crop cutting experiments.
Subsidized premium with farmer share capped at 5% for horticultural and commercial crops.
eligibility: Cultivators of notified perennial horticultural crops (mango, banana, citrus, cashew) in reference weather station command areas.
requiredDocuments: Adangal sowing proof from VAO
Land Patta and Chitta documents
Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook
notes: Weather data is recorded via Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) installed by the State Agricultural Department.

name: Per Drop More Crop - Micro Irrigation Scheme (PMKSY-PDMC)
nameTa: சொட்டு நீர் மற்றும் தெளிப்பு நீர் பாசன மானியத் திட்டம் (PMKSY)
department: Department of Horticulture & Agricultural Engineering, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Centrally sponsored scheme to maximize water use efficiency by subsidizing modern drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems for agricultural and horticultural farmlands.
benefits: 100% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers (up to 5 acres) for installing ISI-standard drip/sprinkler systems.
75% subsidy for other larger landholding farmers.
Saves up to 40-60% irrigation water and increases crop yields by 20-30% via fertigation.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable agricultural land with assured irrigation water source (open well, borewell, or farm pond).
Priority accorded to water-scarce and over-exploited groundwater blocks.
requiredDocuments: Land Patta, Chitta, and FMB sketch
VAO Adangal certificate indicating current crops
Small / Marginal Farmer Certificate issued by Revenue Tahsildar
Water and soil testing report from an authorized laboratory
Field layout sketch and supplier quotation
portalName: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana Portal
notes: Applications are registered online via TNAgrisnet / MIMIS portal and inspected by horticulture field officers.

name: Tamil Nadu Solar Powered Agricultural Pump Sets (PM-KUSUM Component B)
nameTa: சூரிய சக்தியால் இயங்கும் பாசன பம்ப் செட்டுகள் திட்டம் (PM-KUSUM)
department: Agricultural Engineering Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu & MNRE
description: Provides clean solar-powered agricultural pumping solutions to farmers located in off-grid farmlands, eliminating dependence on diesel pumps and erratic grid supply.
benefits: Up to 70% capital subsidy (30% Central Ministry of New and Renewable Energy + 40% Govt of Tamil Nadu) on standalone AC/DC solar pumpsets (5 HP, 7.5 HP, 10 HP).
Farmer contribution restricted to approximately 30% of total installation cost.
Guaranteed daytime irrigation without electricity bills for 25-year panel warranty.
eligibility: Individual farmers having borewells or open wells with sufficient water discharge in areas where grid connection is unavailable or delayed.
Must not have an existing TANGEDCO free electricity connection on the same survey number.
requiredDocuments: Land Patta and Chitta with FMB sketch
VAO certificate of well existence and water discharge suitability
Aadhaar Card and bank passbook
Non-availability certificate of agricultural power service connection
notes: Application intake is released in periodic batches through the Agricultural Engineering Department (AED) and Uzhavan App based on annual state subsidy releases. Confirm current active batch with AED.

name: Tamil Nadu Rainwater Harvesting Farm Ponds Scheme
nameTa: மழைநீர் சேகரிப்பு பண்ணைக் குட்டைகள் அமைக்கும் திட்டம்
department: Agricultural Engineering Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Supports construction of on-farm earthen rainwater storage ponds to harvest runoff during monsoons, recharge groundwater, and provide critical supplemental irrigation.
benefits: 100% subsidy (up to ₹1,00,000 per unit) for creating standardized farm ponds (30m × 30m × 1.5m) using earthmoving machinery.
Stores up to 13.5 lakh liters of rainwater, protecting rainfed crops during mid-season drought.
Provides supplemental farm income through integrated fish culture and duck rearing.
eligibility: Farmers owning rainfed or semi-irrigated agricultural holdings with natural catchment area.
Small and marginal farmers given priority in dryland delta and southern districts.
requiredDocuments: Land revenue Patta and Chitta copy
VAO certified field sketch
Aadhaar Card and bank passbook
notes: Pond subsidies are subject to annual block-wise watershed targets sanctioned by Agricultural Engineering Department. Confirm current watershed allocation with local Assistant Executive Engineer (AED).

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
nameTa: வேளாண் இயந்திரமயமாக்கல் துணை இயக்கம் (SMAM)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India & TN AED
description: Promotes modern farm mechanization to offset agricultural labor shortages, improve field operation timeliness, and reduce input costs through subsidized machinery.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2.00 Lakhs for Tractors, ₹1.00 Lakh for Power Tillers, and ₹4.00 Lakhs for Paddy Transplanters).
Special 50% subsidy concession for Small/Marginal, SC/ST, and women farmers.
Subsidies on laser land levelers, rotavators, multi-crop threshers, and straw balers.
eligibility: Individual farmers holding cultivable land in their own name or family name.
Farmer must not have availed machinery subsidy for the same category in the preceding 5 years.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card copy
Land Patta and Chitta extract
Small / Marginal farmer certificate (if claiming 50% subsidy rate)
Quotation from registered, tested machinery manufacturer or dealer
Bank passbook copy with IFSC code
notes: Applications are selected via online lottery/seniority token system on the Central Agricultural Mechanization Portal.

name: Establishment of Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) for Agricultural Machinery
nameTa: கிராமப்புற வேளாண் இயந்திரங்கள் வாடகை மையங்கள் அமைக்கும் திட்டம் (CHC)
department: Agricultural Engineering Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Establishes village-level agricultural machinery rental hubs so small and marginal farmers can hire expensive modern machinery at reasonable, regulated hourly rental rates.
benefits: 40% capital subsidy (up to ₹10 Lakhs to ₹25 Lakhs per project) for purchasing a package of high-end farm machinery.
Enables Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and entrepreneur groups to operate commercial farm equipment rental services.
Provides small farmers access to combine harvesters, laser levelers, and balers without capital debt.
eligibility: Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs), Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Societies (PACCS), village youth Self Help Groups, and rural entrepreneurs.
Must have suitable space for garaging machinery.
requiredDocuments: FPO / Society registration certificate and resolution
Detailed project report (DPR) with machinery package quotation
Bank loan sanction letter for promoter and bank contribution share
Land or shed ownership/lease document for machinery yard
notes: Target-based capital assistance for FPOs, Cooperative Societies, and rural entrepreneur groups. Proposals submitted through Agricultural Engineering Department.

name: Tamil Nadu Distribution of Subsidized Power Tillers and Weeders
nameTa: மானிய விலையில் பவர் டில்லர்கள் மற்றும் களை எடுக்கும் கருவிகள் வழங்கும் திட்டம்
department: Agricultural Engineering Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Provides targeted capital subsidies on compact power tillers and power weeders to assist smallholders and women farmers in inter-cultivation and seedbed preparation.
benefits: Fixed back-ended capital subsidy of up to ₹85,000 for power tillers (8 HP and above) and up to ₹63,000 for power weeders.
Priority allocation for delta paddy growers and horticultural farmers.
Reduces manual weeding expenses by 60%.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers cultivating wet or dry crops in Tamil Nadu.
Applicant must own a minimum of 1 acre cultivable land.
requiredDocuments: Land Patta and Chitta
Aadhaar Card copy
Small farmer certificate issued by Tahsildar
Dealer proforma invoice for tested model
notes: Subsidies allocated periodically through Uzhavan App and Agricultural Engineering Department. Confirm current district quota with local Assistant Executive Engineer (AED).

name: Kalaignar All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme
nameTa: கலைஞரின் அனைத்து கிராம ஒருங்கிணைந்த வேளாண் வளர்ச்சி திட்டம்
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Multi-departmental convergence programme transforming all village panchayats into self-sufficient agricultural hubs through fallow land rejuvenation, tree sapling distribution, and farm infrastructure.
benefits: Free distribution of high-yielding coconut seedlings (2 seedlings per household).
100% subsidy for community borewells to rejuvenate contiguous dry fallow land clusters (minimum 15 acres).
Distribution of subsidized tarpaulin sheets, micro-nutrient kits, and horticulture saplings.
Soil health test cards issued free of cost to all landholders in notified phase villages.
eligibility: All resident farmers in village panchayats notified under the current financial year phase.
Small, marginal, and tenant farmers holding Patta, Chitta, or Uzhavar Sandhai ID.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card copy
Land Revenue Patta / Chitta extract
Smart Ration Card copy
Active bank passbook with IFSC code
notes: Implemented across 2,500+ village panchayats annually through joint inspections by Revenue and Agriculture officers.

name: Tamil Nadu Free Agricultural Power Supply Scheme
nameTa: விவசாயத்திற்கான இலவச மும்முனை மின்சாரத் திட்டம்
department: TANGEDCO (Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation), Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Pioneering state welfare initiative providing completely free electrical energy for approved agricultural motor pump sets, guaranteeing irrigation security for millions of farmers.
benefits: 100% free unmetered electrical power supply for approved agricultural open-well and borewell electric pump sets.
Subsidized tatkal fast-track electricity service connections for farmers requiring immediate agricultural energized lines.
eligibility: Agricultural landholders owning authorized borewells or open wells with verified cultivable agricultural land.
Must not use the connection for commercial or non-farming activities.
requiredDocuments: TANGEDCO Agricultural Application Form (Form 1)
Land Patta and Chitta documents in applicant's name
Well ownership / Co-ownership certificate from VAO
Aadhaar Card and smart card copy
notes: Administered locally by TANGEDCO section executive engineers; requires submission of annual non-commercial utilization declaration.

name: Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (Farmers Social Security Scheme)
nameTa: முதலமைச்சரின் உழவர் பாதுகாப்புத் திட்டம்
department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: Comprehensive socio-economic security umbrella offering financial relief, educational scholarships, accidental death compensation, and pensions to farmers and landless agricultural workers.
benefits: Accidental death relief compensation of ₹1,00,000 to the nominated family members of deceased registered farmers.
Permanent total disability relief of up to ₹1,00,000 in case of farm accidents.
Monthly old-age social security pension (₹1,000/month) for destitute elderly agricultural laborers.
Educational grants for farmers' children pursuing ITI, Polytechnic, Engineering, and Medical degrees.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable wet land up to 2.5 acres or dry land up to 5.0 acres.
Landless agricultural laborers engaged in farming activities in Tamil Nadu.
requiredDocuments: Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam Member ID card / number
Aadhaar Card and Ration Card
Land revenue Patta or VAO Agricultural Laborer Certificate
Bank account details
notes: Administered through Special Tahsildars (Social Security Schemes) at taluk headquarters across Tamil Nadu.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
nameTa: பிரதம மந்திரி கிசான் சம்மான் நிதி திட்டம் (PM-KISAN)
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
description: Direct income support programme transferring ₹6,000 annually to all eligible landholding farmer families across India to supplement domestic and farming input procurement expenses.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Direct Aadhaar-seeded automated payment with zero intermediary deductions.
Provides financial liquidity ahead of major sowing windows (Kharif, Rabi, Summer).
eligibility: All landholding farmer families who have cultivable land recorded in their names in state revenue land registries.
Excludes institutional landholders, income tax payees, and constitutional post holders.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card with mobile linkage for e-KYC authentication
Land Patta / Land Holding Ownership Record
Active bank account linked with Aadhaar (NPCI Aadhaar mapping)
notes: Biometric or facial recognition e-KYC must be completed online via the PM-KISAN mobile app or at Common Service Centres.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Crop & Animal Husbandry Working Capital
nameTa: விவசாயம் மற்றும் கால்நடை பராமரிப்புக்கான கிசான் கடன் அட்டை (KCC)
department: Department of Agriculture & DAHD, Ministry of Finance, Govt of India & RBI/NABARD
description: Institutional institutional credit framework providing affordable short-term working capital loans to farmers, dairy producers, and livestock rearers with central interest subvention.
benefits: Collateral-free institutional working capital credit up to ₹1.60 Lakhs (and up to ₹3.00 Lakhs for existing account holders).
Attractive concessional interest rate of 7.0% per annum with 3.0% prompt repayment incentive, reducing net effective interest rate to just 4.0% per annum.
Covers recurring costs for seeds, fertilizers, veterinary medicines, concentrate cattle feeds, and labor.
eligibility: All farmers, dairy farmers, cattle owners, sheep/goat rearers, and poultry producers.
Tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and SHG groups are also eligible.
requiredDocuments: Completed KCC application form
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card / Form 60
Land Patta and Chitta or animal ownership proof (Pashu Aadhaar tag)
Passport size photographs
notes: Available through all Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (Tamil Nadu Grama Bank), and Cooperative Banks.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
nameTa: வேளாண் உட்கட்டமைப்பு நிதித் திட்டம் (AIF)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
description: Financing facility providing medium-to-long term debt financing for investment in post-harvest management infrastructure and community agricultural assets such as modern warehouses, cold storage, and processing units.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank term loans up to ₹2.00 Crores for a maximum tenure of 7 years.
Credit guarantee fee coverage under the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE) for loans up to ₹2 Crores.
Encourages construction of digital mandi yards, grading units, pack houses, and assaying labs.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Societies (PACCS), Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Agricultural Entrepreneurs, and Start-ups.
requiredDocuments: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cash-flow projection
Entity registration certificate and audited financial statements
Land ownership or registered lease agreement for project site
Bank loan application form
notes: Loan applications are submitted directly through the online AIF portal and tracked transparently with participating lending institutions.
